<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>TEVORA — Smart Breaks for Smart Teams</title>

<meta name="description"
content="TEVORA - Premium corporate tea, coffee and snacks. Smart breaks for smart teams.">

<style>
@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@600;700;800&display=swap');

:root{
--green:#12372A;
--green2:#1D4D3A;
--cream:#F8F5EE;
--sage:#DCE8DF;
--gold:#C99A45;
--white:#FFFFFF;
--black:#171717;
--gray:#68716B;
--border:#E7E4DC;
--shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(18,55,42,.12);
}

*{
margin:0;
padding:0;
box-sizing:border-box;
}

html{
scroll-behavior:smooth;
}

body{
font-family:Inter,Arial,sans-serif;
background:var(--cream);
color:var(--black);
line-height:1.5;
}

button,input,select,textarea{
font-family:inherit;
}

button{
cursor:pointer;
}

a{
text-decoration:none;
color:inherit;
}

.container{
width:min(1180px,92%);
margin:auto;
}

.navbar{
position:sticky;
top:0;
z-index:1000;
background:rgba(248,245,238,.96);
backdrop-filter:blur(18px);
border-bottom:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.05);
}

.nav-inner{
height:72px;
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:space-between;
}

.logo{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
font-size:25px;
font-weight:800;
letter-spacing:4px;
color:var(--green);
}

.nav-links{
display:none;
}

.nav-order{
border:0;
background:var(--green);
color:#fff;
padding:11px 18px;
border-radius:30px;
font-size:13px;
font-weight:700;
}

.hero{
padding:65px 0 45px;
overflow:hidden;
}

.hero-content{
text-align:center;
}

.badge{
display:inline-flex;
background:var(--sage);
color:var(--green);
padding:8px 14px;
border-radius:30px;
font-size:11px;
font-weight:800;
margin-bottom:20px;
}

.hero h1{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
color:var(--green);
font-size:clamp(43px,10vw,78px);
line-height:1.02;
letter-spacing:-3px;
}

.hero h1 span{
color:var(--gold);
}

.hero p{
max-width:620px;
margin:22px auto;
color:var(--gray);
font-size:16px;
}

.hero-buttons{
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
gap:12px;
margin-top:28px;
}

.btn{
border:0;
padding:15px 24px;
border-radius:35px;
font-size:14px;
font-weight:800;
transition:.2s;
}

.btn:hover{
transform:translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-primary{
background:var(--green);
color:white;
}

.btn-secondary{
background:white;
color:var(--green);
border:1px solid var(--border);
}

.hero-visual{
height:310px;
margin-top:45px;
border-radius:30px;
position:relative;
background:
linear-gradient(rgba(18,55,42,.15),rgba(18,55,42,.30)),
url("data:image/jpeg;base64,")
center/cover;
box-shadow:var(--shadow);
}

.five-card{
position:absolute;
left:18px;
bottom:18px;
background:white;
padding:16px 20px;
border-radius:18px;
box-shadow:0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
}

.five-card strong{
display:block;
font-size:23px;
color:var(--green);
}

.five-card small{
color:var(--gray);
}

.categories{
padding:30px 0 70px;
}

.category-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
gap:12px;
}

.category{
background:white;
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:18px;
padding:22px 16px;
}

.category-icon{
font-size:30px;
}

.category h3{
color:var(--green);
font-size:15px;
margin-top:7px;
}

.category p{
color:var(--gray);
font-size:12px;
}

.section{
padding:75px 0;
}

.section-label{
color:var(--gold);
font-size:11px;
font-weight:800;
letter-spacing:2px;
text-transform:uppercase;
margin-bottom:10px;
}

.section-title{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
color:var(--green);
font-size:clamp(32px,7vw,55px);
line-height:1.07;
letter-spacing:-2px;
}

.section-text{
color:var(--gray);
max-width:620px;
margin-top:16px;
}

.menu-section{
background:white;
}

.menu-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
gap:14px;
margin-top:35px;
}

.product{
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:20px;
padding:15px;
background:white;
}

.product-image{
height:130px;
border-radius:15px;
background-size:cover;
background-position:center;
}

.product:nth-child(1) .product-image{
background-image:url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1544787219-7f47ccb76574?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80");
}

.product:nth-child(2) .product-image{
background-image:url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1495474472287-4d71bcdd2085?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80");
}

.product:nth-child(3) .product-image{
background-image:url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1571934811356-5cc061b6821f?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80");
}

.product:nth-child(4) .product-image{
background-image:url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1623334044303-241021148842?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80");
}

.product:nth-child(5) .product-image{
background-image:url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1499636136210-6f4ee915583e?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80");
}

.product:nth-child(6) .product-image{
background-image:url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1551024506-0bccd828d307?auto=format&fit=crop&w=700&q=80");
}

.product h3{
color:var(--green);
font-size:15px;
margin-top:13px;
}

.product-bottom{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:space-between;
margin-top:8px;
}

.price{
font-weight:800;
}

.add-btn{
border:1px solid var(--green);
background:white;
color:var(--green);
padding:7px 14px;
border-radius:20px;
font-weight:800;
}

.promise{
background:var(--green);
color:white;
text-align:center;
}

.promise .section-label{
color:#D8B56C;
}

.promise .section-title{
color:white;
}

.timer{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
font-size:clamp(75px,20vw,145px);
line-height:1;
letter-spacing:-7px;
margin:25px 0;
}

.promise p{
max-width:600px;
margin:auto;
color:#D8E0DB;
}

.steps{
display:grid;
gap:15px;
margin-top:35px;
}

.step{
background:white;
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:20px;
padding:24px;
}

.step-number{
color:var(--gold);
font-size:12px;
font-weight:800;
}

.step h3{
color:var(--green);
margin:8px 0;
}

.step p{
color:var(--gray);
font-size:14px;
}

.corporate{
background:var(--sage);
}

.plan-grid{
display:grid;
gap:15px;
margin-top:35px;
}

.plan{
background:white;
border-radius:22px;
padding:28px;
}

.plan.featured{
background:var(--green);
color:white;
}

.plan h3{
color:var(--green);
font-size:13px;
letter-spacing:1px;
}

.plan.featured h3{
color:#D8B56C;
}

.plan h2{
color:var(--green);
margin:12px 0;
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
}

.plan.featured h2{
color:white;
}

.plan ul{
list-style:none;
margin:18px 0;
}

.plan li{
margin:9px 0;
color:var(--gray);
font-size:14px;
}

.plan.featured li{
color:#D8E0DB;
}

.event{
background:white;
}

.event-box{
min-height:360px;
padding:45px 25px;
border-radius:28px;
color:white;
display:flex;
flex-direction:column;
justify-content:center;
background:
linear-gradient(rgba(18,55,42,.68),rgba(18,55,42,.68)),
url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1517248135467-4c7edcad34c4?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1400&q=85")
center/cover;
}

.event-box .section-title{
color:white;
max-width:600px;
}

.event-box p{
max-width:600px;
margin:18px 0;
color:#E6ECE8;
}

.why-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
gap:12px;
margin-top:35px;
}

.why{
background:white;
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:18px;
padding:24px;
}

.why-icon{
font-size:28px;
}

.why h3{
color:var(--green);
margin-top:8px;
font-size:15px;
}

.why p{
color:var(--gray);
font-size:12px;
margin-top:5px;
}

.final-cta{
background:var(--green);
text-align:center;
}

.final-cta .section-title{
color:white;
}

.final-cta p{
color:#D8E0DB;
max-width:550px;
margin:18px auto 28px;
}

footer{
background:#0D271D;
color:white;
padding:50px 0 25px;
}

.footer-logo{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
font-size:24px;
font-weight:800;
letter-spacing:4px;
}

.footer-tag{
color:#B9C8BF;
font-size:13px;
margin-top:8px;
}

.footer-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
gap:30px;
margin:35px 0;
}

.footer-column h4{
color:#D8B56C;
font-size:12px;
letter-spacing:1px;
text-transform:uppercase;
margin-bottom:12px;
}

.footer-column a{
display:block;
color:#C7D2CC;
font-size:13px;
margin:7px 0;
}

.copyright{
border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
padding-top:20px;
color:#87988F;
font-size:11px;
}

.whatsapp{
position:fixed;
right:18px;
bottom:18px;
width:55px;
height:55px;
border-radius:50%;
background:#25D366;
color:white;
display:flex;
justify-content:center;
align-items:center;
font-size:24px;
z-index:2000;
box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
}

.modal{
display:none;
position:fixed;
inset:0;
background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);
z-index:3000;
padding:15px;
align-items:center;
justify-content:center;
overflow:auto;
}

.modal.active{
display:flex;
}

.modal-box{
width:100%;
max-width:540px;
max-height:94vh;
overflow:auto;
background:white;
border-radius:25px;
padding:25px;
}

.modal-header{
display:flex;
align-items:flex-start;
justify-content:space-between;
}

.modal-header h2{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
color:var(--green);
}

.modal-header p{
color:var(--gray);
font-size:12px;
}

.close{
border:0;
background:none;
font-size:28px;
color:#555;
}

.form-section{
margin-top:22px;
}

.form-title{
color:var(--green);
font-weight:800;
font-size:14px;
margin-bottom:10px;
}

.form-group{
margin-top:12px;
}

.form-group label{
display:block;
font-size:11px;
font-weight:800;
color:#4D554F;
margin-bottom:5px;
}

.form-group input,
.form-group textarea{
width:100%;
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:11px;
padding:12px;
outline:none;
background:white;
}

.form-group input:focus,
.form-group textarea:focus{
border-color:var(--green);
}

.people-counter{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:space-between;
background:var(--cream);
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:15px;
padding:12px 15px;
}

.counter-label strong{
display:block;
color:var(--green);
font-size:14px;
}

.counter-label small{
color:var(--gray);
font-size:11px;
}

.counter-controls{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
gap:12px;
}

.counter-btn{
width:34px;
height:34px;
border-radius:50%;
border:1px solid var(--green);
background:white;
color:var(--green);
font-size:20px;
font-weight:800;
}

.people-number{
min-width:28px;
text-align:center;
font-weight:800;
color:var(--green);
}

.item-list{
display:grid;
gap:9px;
}

.order-item{
border:1px solid var(--border);
border-radius:14px;
padding:11px;
}

.order-item.selected{
border-color:var(--green);
background:#F5F9F6;
}

.item-top{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
justify-content:space-between;
gap:8px;
}

.item-left{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
gap:9px;
}

.item-check{
width:20px;
height:20px;
accent-color:var(--green);
}

.item-name{
font-weight:700;
color:var(--green);
font-size:13px;
}

.item-price{
font-size:12px;
color:var(--gray);
}

.item-quantity{
display:none;
align-items:center;
justify-content:flex-end;
gap:10px;
margin-top:9px;
}

.order-item.selected .item-quantity{
display:flex;
}

.qty-btn{
width:30px;
height:30px;
border-radius:50%;
border:1px solid var(--green);
background:white;
color:var(--green);
font-weight:800;
font-size:17px;
}

.qty-number{
min-width:25px;
text-align:center;
font-weight:800;
}

.summary{
margin-top:20px;
border-radius:17px;
background:var(--green);
color:white;
padding:17px;
}

.summary-title{
font-weight:800;
font-size:14px;
margin-bottom:10px;
}

.summary-items{
display:grid;
gap:7px;
}

.summary-row{
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
gap:10px;
font-size:12px;
color:#DCE5DF;
}

.summary-total{
border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
margin-top:10px;
padding-top:10px;
display:flex;
justify-content:space-between;
font-size:17px;
font-weight:800;
}

.form-submit{
width:100%;
margin-top:18px;
background:var(--green);
color:white;
}

.form-submit:disabled{
opacity:.6;
}

.notice{
color:var(--gray);
font-size:10px;
margin-top:9px;
text-align:center;
}

.success-message{
display:none;
text-align:center;
padding:30px 15px;
}

.success-message.active{
display:block;
}

.success-icon{
font-size:55px;
margin-bottom:10px;
}

.success-message h2{
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
color:var(--green);
font-size:28px;
}

.success-message p{
color:var(--gray);
margin-top:10px;
}

.success-time{
font-size:38px;
font-family:Manrope,sans-serif;
font-weight:800;
color:var(--gold);
margin:15px 0;
}

@media(min-width:768px){

.nav-links{
display:flex;
align-items:center;
gap:28px;
font-size:13px;
font-weight:600;
}

.hero{
padding:105px 0 70px;
}

.hero-buttons{
flex-direction:row;
justify-content:center;
}

.hero-visual{
height:520px;
border-radius:35px;
}

.category-grid{
grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
}

.menu-grid{
grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
}

.steps{
grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
}

.plan-grid{
grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
}

.why-grid{
grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
}

.footer-grid{
grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);
}

.event-box{
padding:70px;
}

}

/* =========================================
LOGIN / MY ORDERS / CANCEL / REORDER
========================================= */
.account-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-shrink:0}
.account-btn{border:1px solid var(--border);background:white;color:var(--green);padding:9px 12px;border-radius:22px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.account-btn.primary{background:var(--green);color:white;border-color:var(--green)}
.account-btn.danger{background:#fff4f2;color:#a32920;border-color:#f1c9c4}
.account-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
@media(max-width:767px){.account-btn{padding:8px 9px;font-size:11px}.nav-order{padding:9px 11px;font-size:11px}.account-actions{gap:4px}}
.account-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;z-index:3000}
.account-modal.active{display:flex}
.account-box{width:min(680px,100%);max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;background:var(--cream);border-radius:24px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.3);padding:24px}
.account-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:15px;margin-bottom:18px}
.account-header h2{margin:0;color:var(--green)}
.account-header p{margin:5px 0 0;color:#68736d;font-size:13px}
.account-close{border:0;background:transparent;font-size:30px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--green);line-height:1}
.login-field{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center}
.login-field input{flex:1}
.login-note{font-size:12px;color:#68736d;margin-top:9px}
.order-card{background:white;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin:12px 0}
.order-card-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.order-id{font-weight:900;color:var(--green);font-size:15px}
.order-date{font-size:11px;color:#777;margin-top:4px}
.order-status{padding:6px 10px;border-radius:20px;background:#eef6f1;color:var(--green);font-size:11px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap}
.order-status.cancelled{background:#fff0ee;color:#a32920}
.order-items{white-space:pre-line;font-size:13px;color:#4d5752;margin:12px 0}
.order-meta{font-size:12px;color:#68736d;line-height:1.7}
.order-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.order-action{border:0;border-radius:22px;padding:9px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.order-action.reorder{background:var(--green);color:white}
.order-action.cancel{background:#fff0ee;color:#a32920;border:1px solid #efc9c4}
.empty-orders{text-align:center;padding:28px 10px;color:#68736d}
.loading-orders{text-align:center;padding:28px;color:#68736d}

</style>
</head>

<body>

<header class="navbar">
<div class="container nav-inner">

<a href="#" class="logo">TEVORA</a>

<nav class="nav-links">
<a href="#menu">Menu</a>
<a href="#how">How It Works</a>
<a href="#corporate">Corporate</a>
<a href="#events">Events</a>
<a href="#contact">Contact</a>
</nav>

<div class="account-actions">
<button class="account-btn" id="loginNavBtn" onclick="openLogin()">Login</button>
<button class="account-btn" id="ordersNavBtn" onclick="openMyOrders()">My Orders</button>
<button class="account-btn danger" id="logoutNavBtn" onclick="logoutUser()" style="display:none">Logout</button>
<button class="nav-order" onclick="openOrder()">Order Now</button>
</div>

</div>
</header>

<section class="hero">
<div class="container">

<div class="hero-content">

<div class="badge">
🚚 READY IN 5 MINUTES
</div>

<h1>
Smart Breaks for <span>Smart Teams.</span>
</h1>

<p>
Premium tea, coffee and snacks made for modern workplaces.
Simple ordering. Fast preparation. Better breaks.
</p>

<div class="hero-buttons">

<button class="btn btn-primary" onclick="openOrder()">
Order Now →
</button>

<a href="#corporate" class="btn btn-secondary">
Corporate Plans
</a>

</div>

</div>

<div class="hero-visual">

<div class="five-card">
<strong>05:00</strong>
<small>Ready in 5 minutes</small>
</div>

</div>

</div>
</section>

<section class="categories">
<div class="container">

<div class="category-grid">

<div class="category">
<div class="category-icon">☕</div>
<h3>Tea</h3>
<p>Fresh office tea</p>
</div>

<div class="category">
<div class="category-icon">☕</div>
<h3>Coffee</h3>
<p>Hot & refreshing</p>
</div>

<div class="category">
<div class="category-icon">🥐</div>
<h3>Snacks</h3>
<p>Fresh office bites</p>
</div>

<div class="category">
<div class="category-icon">📦</div>
<h3>Corporate Packs</h3>
<p>Made for teams</p>
</div>

</div>
</div>
</section>

<section class="section">
<div class="container">

<div class="section-label">
THE TEVORA EXPERIENCE
</div>

<h2 class="section-title">
Your Office Break,<br>
Upgraded.
</h2>

<p class="section-text">
From the first morning meeting to the final afternoon deadline,
TEVORA keeps your team refreshed with quality beverages and snacks.
</p>

</div>
</section>

<section class="section menu-section" id="menu">
<div class="container">

<div class="section-label">
OUR MENU

<script>

/* =========================================
SUPABASE CONNECTION
========================================= */

const SUPABASE_URL =
"https://eaowxilhfzyukzetgqxo.supabase.co";

const SUPABASE_KEY =
"sb_publishable_Z3xsADypaOjX8GEQEOLUdg_vbxynHRx";


/* =========================================
WHATSAPP
========================================= */

const WHATSAPP_NUMBER =
"919701508591";


/* =========================================
PRODUCTS
========================================= */

const products = {

"Classic Tea":{
price:15,
emoji:"☕"
},

"Premium Coffee":{
price:25,
emoji:"☕"
},

"Masala Tea":{
price:20,
emoji:"🌿"
},

"Veg Puff":{
price:25,
emoji:"🥐"
},

"Cookies":{
price:20,
emoji:"🍪"
},

"Tea + Snack Combo":{
price:39,
emoji:"📦"
}

};


/* =========================================
ORDER STATE
========================================= */


let peopleCount = 1;

let orderItems = {};

/* =========================================
PHONE LOGIN STATE
========================================= */
let loggedInPhone = localStorage.getItem("tevora_logged_phone") || "";

function normalizePhone(value){
return String(value || "").replace(/\D/g, "").slice(-10);
}

function validPhone(value){
return /^[6-9]\d{9}$/.test(normalizePhone(value));
}

function updateLoginUI(){
const loginBtn = document.getElementById("loginNavBtn");
const ordersBtn = document.getElementById("ordersNavBtn");
const logoutBtn = document.getElementById("logoutNavBtn");
if(loginBtn) loginBtn.style.display = loggedInPhone ? "none" : "inline-block";
if(ordersBtn) ordersBtn.style.display = loggedInPhone ? "inline-block" : "none";
if(logoutBtn) logoutBtn.style.display = loggedInPhone ? "inline-block" : "none";
}

function openLogin(){
document.getElementById("loginModal").classList.add("active");
const input = document.getElementById("loginPhone");
input.value = loggedInPhone || "";
setTimeout(()=>input.focus(),50);
}

function closeLogin(){
document.getElementById("loginModal").classList.remove("active");
}

function loginUser(){
const phone = normalizePhone(document.getElementById("loginPhone").value);
if(!validPhone(phone)){
alert("Please enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number.");
return;
}
loggedInPhone = phone;
localStorage.setItem("tevora_logged_phone", phone);
updateLoginUI();
closeLogin();
alert("✅ Login successful!");
}

function logoutUser(){
loggedInPhone = "";
localStorage.removeItem("tevora_logged_phone");
updateLoginUI();
alert("You have been logged out.");
}

function openMyOrders(){
if(!loggedInPhone){
openLogin();
return;
}
document.getElementById("ordersModal").classList.add("active");
document.getElementById("ordersUserText").textContent = "Orders for +91 " + loggedInPhone;
loadMyOrders();
}

function closeMyOrders(){
document.getElementById("ordersModal").classList.remove("active");
}

function escapeHtml(value){
return String(value ?? "").replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;","'":"&#39;"}[ch]));
}

async function loadMyOrders(){
const list = document.getElementById("ordersList");
list.innerHTML = '<div class="loading-orders">Loading your orders...</div>';
try{
const phoneVariants = [...new Set([
loggedInPhone,
"91" + loggedInPhone,
"+91" + loggedInPhone
])];
let orders = [];
for(const phoneVariant of phoneVariants){
const response = await fetch(
SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/bookings?mobile=eq." + encodeURIComponent(phoneVariant) + "&select=*&order=created_at.desc",
{
method:"GET",
headers:{
"apikey":SUPABASE_KEY,
"Authorization":"Bearer "+SUPABASE_KEY
}
}
);
if(!response.ok) throw new Error(await response.text());
orders = orders.concat(await response.json());
}
const seenOrders = new Set();
orders = orders.filter(order => {
const key = order.id || order.order_id;
if(seenOrders.has(key)) return false;
seenOrders.add(key);
return true;
}).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.created_at||0)-new Date(a.created_at||0));
if(!orders.length){
list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-orders">No orders found for this phone number.</div>';
return;
}
list.innerHTML = orders.map(order => {
const cancelled = String(order.status || "").toLowerCase() === "cancelled";
const created = order.created_at ? new Date(order.created_at).toLocaleString("en-IN") : "";
return `
<div class="order-card">
<div class="order-card-top">
<div><div class="order-id">${escapeHtml(order.order_id || "TEVORA Order")}</div><div class="order-date">${escapeHtml(created)}</div></div>
<span class="order-status ${cancelled ? "cancelled" : ""}">${escapeHtml(order.status || "New")}</span>
</div>
<div class="order-items">${escapeHtml(order.items || "No items")}</div>
<div class="order-meta">
<b>Total:</b> ₹${escapeHtml(order.total_amount ?? 0)}<br>
<b>People:</b> ${escapeHtml(order.people ?? 1)} &nbsp; <b>Office:</b> ${escapeHtml(order.office_location || "-")}<br>
<b>Delivery:</b> ${escapeHtml(order.delivery_date || "-")} ${escapeHtml(order.delivery_time || "")}
</div>
<div class="order-actions">
<button class="order-action reorder" onclick='reorderFromOrder(${JSON.stringify(order.items || "")})'>🔄 Reorder</button>
${cancelled ? "" : `<button class="order-action cancel" onclick='cancelOrder(${JSON.stringify(order.order_id || "")})'>❌ Cancel Order</button>`}
</div>
</div>`;
}).join("");
}catch(error){
console.error(error);
list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-orders">❌ Could not load orders. Please check Supabase SELECT/RLS policy.</div>';
}
}

async function cancelOrder(orderId){
if(!orderId || !loggedInPhone) return;
if(!confirm("Cancel order " + orderId + "?")) return;
try{
const phoneVariants = [...new Set([loggedInPhone, "91" + loggedInPhone, "+91" + loggedInPhone])];
let response = null;
for(const phoneVariant of phoneVariants){
response = await fetch(
SUPABASE_URL + "/rest/v1/bookings?order_id=eq." + encodeURIComponent(orderId) + "&mobile=eq." + encodeURIComponent(phoneVariant),
{
method:"PATCH",
headers:{
"apikey":SUPABASE_KEY,
"Authorization":"Bearer "+SUPABASE_KEY,
"Content-Type":"application/json",
"Prefer":"return=representation"
},
body:JSON.stringify({status:"Cancelled"})
}
);
if(!response.ok) throw new Error(await response.text());
const changed = await response.json();
if(changed.length) break;
}
alert("✅ Order cancelled successfully.");
loadMyOrders();
}catch(error){
console.error(error);
alert("❌ Cancel failed. Please check Supabase UPDATE/RLS policy.");
}
}

function reorderFromOrder(itemText){
resetOrderForm();
const lines = String(itemText || "").split("\\n");
lines.forEach(line=>{
const match = line.match(/(?:☕|🌿|🥐|🍪|📦)?\\s*(.+?)\\s*×\\s*(\\d+)\\s*=\\s*₹/);
if(match && products[match[1].trim()]){
const name = match[1].trim();
const qty = Math.max(1, parseInt(match[2],10) || 1);
const safe = getSafeId(name);
const checkbox = document.getElementById("check-"+safe);
if(checkbox){
checkbox.checked = true;
orderItems[name] = qty;
document.getElementById("item-"+safe)?.classList.add("selected");
document.getElementById("qty-"+safe).textContent = qty;
}
}
});
updateSummary();
openOrder();
}



/* =========================================
OPEN ORDER
========================================= */

function openOrder(){

document
.getElementById("orderModal")
.classList.add("active");

document
.getElementById("orderFormContent")
.style.display="block";

document
.getElementById("successMessage")
.classList.remove("active");

if(loggedInPhone){
document.getElementById("phone").value = loggedInPhone;
}

}


/* =========================================
OPEN WITH ITEM
========================================= */

function openOrderWithItem(item){

openOrder();

setTimeout(()=>{

const safe = getSafeId(item);

const checkbox =
document.getElementById("check-"+safe);

if(checkbox && !checkbox.checked){

checkbox.checked = true;

toggleItem(item);

}

},100);

}


/* =========================================
CLOSE
========================================= */

function closeOrder(){

document
.getElementById("orderModal")
.classList.remove("active");

}


/* =========================================
PEOPLE
========================================= */

function changePeople(amount){

peopleCount += amount;

if(peopleCount < 1){
peopleCount = 1;
}

document
.getElementById("peopleCount")
.textContent = peopleCount;

}


/* =========================================
SAFE ID
========================================= */

function getSafeId(name){

return name
.replace(/\+/g,"")
.replace(/\s+/g,"-");

}


/* =========================================
TOGGLE ITEM
========================================= */

function toggleItem(name){

const safe = getSafeId(name);

const checkbox =
document.getElementById("check-"+safe);

const itemBox =
document.getElementById("item-"+safe);

if(checkbox.checked){

orderItems[name] = 1;

itemBox.classList.add("selected");

document
.getElementById("qty-"+safe)
.textContent = 1;

}else{

delete orderItems[name];

itemBox.classList.remove("selected");

}

updateSummary();

}


/* =========================================
QUANTITY
========================================= */

function changeQty(name,amount){

if(!orderItems[name]){
return;
}

orderItems[name] += amount;

if(orderItems[name] < 1){
orderItems[name] = 1;
}

const safe = getSafeId(name);

document
.getElementById("qty-"+safe)
.textContent = orderItems[name];

updateSummary();

}


/* =========================================
SUMMARY
========================================= */

function updateSummary(){

const summary =
document.getElementById("summaryItems");

summary.innerHTML = "";

let total = 0;

const names = Object.keys(orderItems);

if(names.length === 0){

summary.innerHTML = `
<div class="summary-row">
<span>No items selected</span>
<span>₹0</span>
</div>
`;

}

names.forEach(name=>{

const qty = orderItems[name];

const price = products[name].price;

const amount = qty * price;

total += amount;

const row =
document.createElement("div");

row.className = "summary-row";

row.innerHTML = `
<span>
${products[name].emoji}
${name} × ${qty}
</span>

<span>
₹${amount}
</span>
`;

summary.appendChild(row);

});

document
.getElementById("totalAmount")
.textContent = "₹"+total;

}


/* =========================================
CREATE ORDER ID
========================================= */

function generateOrderId(){

const now = new Date();

const datePart =
now.getFullYear().toString() +
String(now.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0") +
String(now.getDate()).padStart(2,"0");

const random =
Math.floor(1000 + Math.random()*9000);

return "TVR-" + datePart + "-" + random;

}


/* =========================================
PLACE ORDER — SUPABASE
========================================= */

async function placeOrder(){

const button =
document.getElementById("submitButton");

const company =
document.getElementById("company").value.trim();

const contactName =
document.getElementById("contactName").value.trim();

const phone = loggedInPhone || document.getElementById("phone").value.trim();

if(loggedInPhone){
document.getElementById("phone").value = loggedInPhone;
}

const location =
document.getElementById("location").value.trim();

const date =
document.getElementById("deliveryDate").value;

const time =
document.getElementById("deliveryTime").value;

const note =
document.getElementById("note").value.trim();


/* VALIDATION */

if(!company){

alert("Please enter company name.");
return;

}

if(!contactName){

alert("Please enter contact person name.");
return;

}

if(!phone){

alert("Please enter mobile number.");
return;

}

if(!location){

alert("Please enter office location.");
return;

}

if(Object.keys(orderItems).length === 0){

alert("Please select at least one item.");
return;

}


/* =========================================
TOTAL + ITEMS
========================================= */

let total = 0;

let itemText = "";

Object.keys(orderItems).forEach(name=>{

const qty = orderItems[name];

const price = products[name].price;

const amount = qty * price;

total += amount;

itemText +=
`${products[name].emoji} ${name} × ${qty} = ₹${amount}\n`;

});


/* =========================================
ORDER ID
========================================= */

const orderId =
generateOrderId();


/* =========================================
SUPABASE DATA

IMPORTANT:
TABLE COLUMN IS "nodes"
NOT "notes"
========================================= */

const bookingData = {

order_id: orderId,

company_name: company,

contact_person: contactName,

mobile: phone,

office_location: location,

people: peopleCount,

items: itemText,

total_amount: total,

delivery_date: date || null,

delivery_time: time || null,

nodes: note || null,

status: "New"

};


button.disabled = true;

button.textContent =
"Saving Order...";


try{

/* =========================================
INSERT INTO SUPABASE
========================================= */

const response =
await fetch(
SUPABASE_URL +
"/rest/v1/bookings",
{
method:"POST",

headers:{
"apikey":SUPABASE_KEY,
"Authorization":"Bearer "+SUPABASE_KEY,
"Content-Type":"application/json",
"Prefer":"return=representation"
},

body:
JSON.stringify(bookingData)
}
);


/* =========================================
CHECK SUPABASE RESPONSE
========================================= */

if(!response.ok){

const errorText =
await response.text();

console.error(
"Supabase Error:",
errorText
);

throw new Error(
"Supabase insert failed: " +
errorText
);

}


/* =========================================
SUCCESS
========================================= */

document
.getElementById("orderFormContent")
.style.display="none";

document
.getElementById("successMessage")
.classList.add("active");


/* =========================================
OPTIONAL WHATSAPP MESSAGE

WhatsApp is NOT automatically opened.
========================================= */

console.log(
"Order saved successfully:",
orderId
);

resetOrderForm();


}catch(error){

console.error(error);

alert(
"❌ Order could not be saved.\n\nPlease check your Supabase RLS INSERT policy."
);

}finally{

button.disabled = false;

button.textContent =
"Place Corporate Order →";

}

}


/* =========================================
RESET
========================================= */

function resetOrderForm(){

document.getElementById("company").value="";

document.getElementById("contactName").value="";

document.getElementById("phone").value="";

document.getElementById("location").value="";

document.getElementById("deliveryDate").value="";

document.getElementById("deliveryTime").value="";

document.getElementById("note").value="";


peopleCount = 1;

document
.getElementById("peopleCount")
.textContent="1";


Object.keys(products).forEach(name=>{

const safe =
getSafeId(name);

const checkbox =
document.getElementById("check-"+safe);

const item =
document.getElementById("item-"+safe);

const qty =
document.getElementById("qty-"+safe);

if(checkbox){
checkbox.checked=false;
}

if(item){
item.classList.remove("selected");
}

if(qty){
qty.textContent="1";
}

});


orderItems = {};

updateSummary();

}


/* =========================================
OUTSIDE CLICK
========================================= */

window.addEventListener(
"click",
function(e){

const modal =
document.getElementById("orderModal");

if(e.target === modal){
closeOrder();
}

});


/* =========================================
ESC
========================================= */

document.addEventListener(
"keydown",
function(e){

if(e.key === "Escape"){
closeOrder();
}

});

/* =========================================
ACCOUNT MODAL OUTSIDE CLICK / INIT
========================================= */
window.addEventListener("click", function(e){
if(e.target === document.getElementById("loginModal")) closeLogin();
if(e.target === document.getElementById("ordersModal")) closeMyOrders();
});

updateLoginUI();

</script>

</body>
</html>
